# Christopher G. Connell

<div class="hero-rule"></div>

Research in **differential geometry**, geometric topology, rigidity theory, and the geometric aspects of dynamical systems and random walks.

## Research at a glance

::: {.feature-grid}
::: {.feature-card}
<span class="feature-index">01 / GEOMETRY</span>

### Rigidity and curvature

Geometric rigidity, nonpositive curvature, locally symmetric spaces, and geodesic flows.

[Research directions](research.qmd)
:::
::: {.feature-card}
<span class="feature-index">02 / TOPOLOGY</span>

### Geometry and topology

Simplicial volume, homological invariants, and interactions between geometry and topology.

[Selected papers](publications.qmd)
:::
::: {.feature-card}
<span class="feature-index">03 / DYNAMICS</span>

### Dynamics and random walks

Geometric aspects of ergodic theory, random walks, and related dynamical phenomena.

[Research interests](research.qmd)
